:::{#def-fisher-scoring}
#### Fisher scoring

**Fisher scoring** (also called the method of scoring)
is the [Newton-Raphson algorithm](#def-newton-raphson)
with the observed information $\oinf(\vx; \esttmp{\param})$ in the update
replaced by the [expected information](#def-einf) $\einf(\esttmp{\param})$:

$$
\esttmp{\param} \leftarrow \esttmp{\param} + \inv{\einff{\esttmp{\param}}} \scoref{\vx; \esttmp{\param}}
$$

:::
